scope: G1 full 8 fresh seeds x both seats; no G1 block has yet run
threshold_unit: Within each seat independently pool raw numerators and denominators over the exact complete preregistered eight-seed block; both seats must satisfy every G1 proportion threshold.
per_game_disclosure: Keep each game raw numerators/denominators/ratios, worst game and below-threshold game count. No deletion or seat pooling to overwrite a failed seat.
no_error_dilution: Any G0 error, missing evidence, nonzero conservation residual or unverified procurement chain prevents a pass regardless of aggregate ratios.
interpretation: The protocol specifies proportions and reporting by seat; it never specified every individual game must independently exceed each proportion. A single-game diagnostic cannot confer G1 qualification.
first_water_denominator: Every actual PLANT accepted by the official engine, detected externally regardless of strategy self-reporting. Prospective target assignments that were cancelled before spending a seed are separately disclosed and do not create a plant exposure; all actual plantings count including omitted strategy logs.
first_water_required: Official first-water evidence within the actual planting day, measured for every actual planting. Any last-day unobserved planting receipt remains pending until external final state verifies it.
